items.text: Toy Story, the first full-length computer-animated feature film, was released by Pixar and Walt Disney Pictures on November 22, 1995.
items.question: Who did you take to see Toy Story, or who took you?
items.source_quote: November 22 – The first ever full-length computer-animated feature film, Toy Story, is released by Pixar and Walt Disney Pictures.

items.text: Mariah Carey's "Fantasy" was the longest-running number-one single of 1995 on the Billboard Hot 100, with eight weeks at the top of the chart.
items.question: Where were you living when Mariah Carey's "Fantasy" was on the radio, and who turned it up?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles of the United States.
The longest running number-one single of 1995 is "Fantasy" by Mariah Carey, which logged eight weeks atop the chart.

items.text: On October 28, 1995, the Atlanta Braves defeated the Cleveland Indians, 4 games to 2, to win the World Series.
items.question: Who did you watch the 1995 World Series with, and were you rooting for the Braves or the Indians?
items.source_quote: October 28 – The Atlanta Braves defeat the Cleveland Indians, 4 games to 2, to win their first World Series Title in Atlanta.
